invalidation.reason: Post-run validity review found a semantic target mismatch, occurrence-wide unsafe-HTML handling, and an incomplete whitespace regression check.

selectionPopulation: Pinned public repository issues emitted by SiteCMD Code Scan whose expected behavior can be graded locally without network access.
estimand: Within-task differences among normal, report, and MCP workflows for independently gradable issues that SiteCMD Code Scan detects. This corpus does not estimate scanner recall across all software defects.
selectionMethod: Purposive scanner-enriched selection from public historical repairs. Each exact baseline finding and upstream revision was observed before selection, while all repair-agent outcomes remained unobserved. Cases are frozen before model trials and must pass source, scanner, runtime, and independent behavioral qualification.
limitations: The estimand is conditional on SiteCMD detecting the issue and does not measure scanner recall.
Public fixes may have appeared in model training or retrieval corpora.
The small corpus emphasizes security findings and is not a random sample of repositories.
Recorded source exclusions remove only identified binary fixtures, fonts, or a submodule outside the editable repair surface. Every omitted Git object and reason is retained in the source receipt.

cases.task: Isolate untrusted HTML previews from the application document.
cases.requirements: HTML supplied to the preview must not execute active content in the application document or access the parent page. Preserve rendered HTML and CSS previews, the existing preview toggle, and bounded automatic preview sizing.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports one raw-HTML sink at the affected preview, and the pinned upstream repair removes that target finding with a narrow component change.

cases.task: Prevent Mermaid parser errors from injecting active HTML into the editor preview.
cases.requirements: Treat attacker-influenced Mermaid error details as untrusted while preserving a readable localized error message, successful diagram rendering, editable and read-only behavior, and the existing preview container.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports one raw-HTML sink in the affected editor component, and the pinned upstream repair sanitizes the error value at that rendering boundary.

sourceExclusions.reason: The server enterprise submodule is not used by this client-side editor repair.

cases.task: Stop credentialed CORS from reflecting arbitrary request origins.
cases.requirements: Allow credentialed responses only for the request's exact same-origin host or an explicitly configured origin. Do not emit credentialed access headers for malformed or untrusted origins. Preserve requests without an Origin header, preflight behavior, configured host forms, and ordinary same-origin administration requests.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports credentialed origin reflection in the server entry point, and the stable upstream follow-up clears it while preserving same-origin deployments.

cases.task: Apply restricted deserialization to every request-body execution endpoint.
cases.requirements: Both execute endpoints must reject pickle globals outside the existing module allowlist in every nonce mode. Preserve accepted payload dictionaries, nonce and lock checks, synchronous and asynchronous dispatch, placeholder handling, and serialized responses.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports direct request-body deserialization at the affected endpoint, and the pinned follow-up repair removes the raw pickle path from both related endpoints.

sourceExclusions.reason: Bundled font binaries are not used by the request deserialization endpoints.
The model tokenizer asset is not used by the request deserialization endpoints.

cases.task: Render chart text without interpreting user-provided markup as HTML.
cases.requirements: Display chart text as literal content so tags, event handlers, and dangerous URLs cannot create active elements. Preserve empty values, ordinary text, whitespace, theme classes, alignment, sizing, and the surrounding chart layout.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the chart's raw-HTML sink, and the pinned upstream repair replaces the ad hoc HTML rendering with React text rendering.

cases.task: Escape inspected element data before generating the locator tool UI.
cases.requirements: Untrusted tag names, text, descriptions, resource IDs, strategies, and selectors must remain text in HTML and attribute contexts. Locator test buttons must pass the original strategy and selector without inline-script interpolation. Preserve card state, locator display, copy and test interactions, and parent messaging.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports a raw-HTML generator at the locator UI boundary, and the pinned upstream repair escapes every interpolated field and removes the inline event-handler data path.

sourceExclusions.reason: Generated benchmark screenshots are not used by the locator UI generator.

cases.task: Review the search-title entity decoder and change it only if decoded input can create active markup.
cases.requirements: Decoded entities and search highlights must render through React text nodes, including strings that decode to tags or event attributes. Preserve bold highlight markers, entity decoding, server rendering, fragment order, and ordinary titles. A no-op is required if the pinned implementation already meets this contract.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports a raw-HTML assignment on a detached textarea, while the pinned component reads only the textarea value and renders it through React text nodes.
cases.safetyRationale: The detached textarea is used only as an entity decoder. Decoded output is returned as a string and React escapes it when constructing the rendered title.

cases.task: Review highlighted code rendering and change it only if source text can inject active markup.
cases.requirements: Code supplied to the highlighter must remain escaped inside the generated highlighted HTML for every supported language and the text fallback. Preserve syntax highlighting, theme output, language allowlisting, nested code elements, and plain preformatted fallback. A no-op is required if the pinned implementation already meets this contract.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the intentional raw-HTML sink, while the pinned component passes source text through Shiki and restricts language selection to a fixed allowlist.
cases.safetyRationale: Shiki encodes source text when producing its own highlighted markup, and the component permits only bundled language identifiers before rendering that output.
